headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of strategic‑base exchanges has sharpened across six sectors. Weathered Expanse now records twenty‑seven flips in the past day, its butcher’s bill climbing to 156,989 Colonial and 172,786 Warden dead with 7,744 fresh enlistments per hour; Warden casualties are accelerating while Colonial losses hold steady. Fishermans Row remains the hottest zone with thirty‑two flips, Colonial casualties modest at sixty‑seven but Warden losses rising to two‑hundred‑one and enlistments cooling to one‑ninety per hour. Linn Mercy holds seventeen flips driven by Lathair, posting 3,884 Colonial and 6,537 Warden losses and 903 enlistments; casualties accelerate while recruitment cools. Mooring County shows eleven flips yet sees 4,000 Colonial and 3,438 Warden dead and 896 enlistments, all rates accelerating. Stlican Shelf registers fourteen flips with casualties surging to 4,586 Colonial and 6,963 Warden and enlistments steady at 765 per hour. Stonecradle adds thirteen flips, 5,068 Colonial and 7,349 Warden casualties and 823 enlistments, both casualty streams accelerating. Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors remain static, with no ownership changes reported.
